facts.claim: Beyonce's engagement ring from Jay-Z is attributed to jeweller Lorraine Schwartz and centres on an emerald-cut diamond.
The diamond is reported as about 18 carats (an estimate quoted by Hello!, not an official figure), set on a platinum split shank.
facts.conflicts: Split-shank and platinum detail from one outlet only; carat is a jeweller estimate.

facts.claim: Engagement timing: Hello! reports a December 2007 proposal; Vogue Singapore gives early 2008; the couple married in April 2008.
facts.conflicts: Proposal date differs (Dec 2007 vs early 2008). Safe wording: 'engaged before their April 2008 wedding'.

facts.claim: Style family for Get the look: emerald-cut solitaire (step cut).
Amal Clooney (then Alamuddin) and George Clooney became engaged in 2014; the ring was widely reported in late April / May 2014 and the couple married in Venice in 2014.
The ring is an emerald-cut diamond reported as about 7 carats, with a tapered baguette diamond on each side, set in platinum.
facts.conflicts: Some outlets give 7 to 8 carats (retailer estimate).

facts.claim: George Clooney was reported to have been involved in designing the ring himself.
Style family for Get the look: emerald-cut with tapered baguette side stones (three-stone / side-stone).
Blake Lively's engagement ring from Ryan Reynolds is attributed to jeweller Lorraine Schwartz, with Reynolds reported to have been involved in the design.
The centre stone is an oval pink diamond set on a rose gold band with pave diamonds.
facts.conflicts: Carat reported as about 12 carats by most outlets, 7 carats by one retailer blog. Omit carat.

facts.claim: The couple became engaged in 2012 and married in September 2012 in South Carolina; the ring was first widely seen after the wedding.
Style family for Get the look: coloured diamond (oval).
Hailey Bieber (then Baldwin) and Justin Bieber became engaged in July 2018; the ring was shown on the September 2018 cover of Vogue Mexico, revealed in August 2018.
The ring was custom made by Jack Solow of Solow & Co., who told People it is an elongated oval diamond on a thin band.
facts.conflicts: Carat estimates range from 4 to 10 carats; omit carat. A hidden halo is mentioned by one blog only; omit.

facts.claim: In 2024 Hailey Bieber was reported to be wearing a new oval diamond ring attributed to Lorraine Schwartz; the original 2018 ring is the Solow design.
Style family for Get the look: oval solitaire.
Dave McCary announced his engagement to Emma Stone on Instagram on 4 December 2019.
Kataoka confirmed to National Jeweler that the ring is its 'Pearl Snowflake Ring Supreme' in 18-carat gold with an 8 mm untreated Akoya pearl framed by diamonds.
facts.conflicts: Retail price appears in source: do not use.

facts.claim: Style family for Get the look: alternative centre stone (pearl) with diamond cluster or halo.
Priyanka Chopra and Nick Jonas confirmed their engagement on Instagram in August 2018.
The ring is a Tiffany & Co. cushion-cut diamond with tapered baguette side stones; Jonas was reported to have closed a Tiffany store to choose it.
facts.conflicts: Carat estimates range from 3 to 5+; omit carat. Brief called it a solitaire; side baguettes make it side-stone.

facts.claim: Style family for Get the look: cushion-cut with tapered baguette side stones (side-stone).
Jonathan Owens proposed to Simone Biles on Valentine's Day 2022 (14 February 2022).
The ring was made by Houston jeweller Zo Frost and has an oval diamond with a halo and a diamond band; Frost said Owens wanted a halo around the oval.
facts.conflicts: Carat reported as 3 carats (InStore) vs 6 to 8 carats (designer estimate in Hola); omit carat.

facts.claim: Style family for Get the look: oval halo.
Selena Gomez announced her engagement to Benny Blanco on Instagram on 11 December 2024.
The ring is a marquise-cut diamond solitaire on a slim band.
facts.conflicts: Carat estimates 4 to 8 carats from retailers; omit. Band metal (yellow gold pave) from one jeweller estimate only.

facts.claim: Style family for Get the look: fancy shape (marquise) solitaire.
Lady Gaga and Michael Polansky's engagement was reported as April 2024; she publicly referred to him as her fiance at the Paris Olympics in July 2024.
The ring is reported as a large oval-cut diamond on an 18-carat white and rose gold pave band with pink diamond accents, attributed to Sofia Jewelry.
facts.conflicts: Brief said rose-cut: NOT supported; every source says oval-cut. Carat estimates 8 to 20; omit.

facts.claim: Style family for Get the look: oval with coloured diamond accents (not vintage rose-cut).
Sofia Richie announced her engagement to Elliot Grainge on Instagram in April 2022; the proposal was reported to have taken place in Hawaii.
The ring is an emerald-cut diamond reported as about 6 carats (an estimate from the Platinum Guild International president quoted by Marie Claire) on a thin band.
facts.conflicts: One outlet suggested cushion cut and one yellow gold; most say emerald cut, platinum.

facts.claim: Style family for Get the look: emerald-cut solitaire.
Taylor Swift announced her engagement to Travis Kelce on Instagram on 26 August 2025, including a close-up of the ring (AP).
A representative confirmed the ring was designed by Kindred Lubeck, who operates Artifex Fine Jewelry in New York; publicist Tree Paine said the diamond is an old mine brilliant cut (AP).
The diamond is in a yellow gold bezel setting (AP).
facts.conflicts: Brief said 'elongated cushion': AP says only 'old mine brilliant cut'. No carat published by her team; omit.

facts.claim: Style family for Get the look: vintage-inspired (antique cut, yellow gold).
Zendaya wore the ring at the Golden Globes in January 2025; People and TMZ then reported the engagement to Tom Holland, citing sources.
The ring is reported as an elongated cushion-cut diamond set east-west (horizontally) in a Georgian-style cut-down setting in white and yellow gold.
The ring was identified by jewellery historian Marion Fasel as a Jessica McCormack design; the designer had not publicly confirmed it at the time of reporting. Reported as about 5 carats.
Style family for Get the look: east-west setting (supported by sources).
Australian-born model Miranda Kerr announced her engagement to Evan Spiegel in July 2016.
The ring has a round-cut centre diamond set between two tapered baguettes; US Weekly (via InStore) reported it as about 2.5 carats.
facts.conflicts: Brief said solitaire: sources describe three stones. Other estimates 1.5 to 2.5 carats.

facts.claim: Style family for Get the look: round three-stone (trilogy).
Jennifer Lawrence's engagement to Cooke Maroney was reported in February 2019.
She debuted the ring at Dior's Fall 2019 show at Paris Fashion Week in late February 2019; it is described as a large elongated cushion or emerald-cut diamond solitaire on a thin band.
facts.conflicts: Cut described as emerald or elongated cushion; carat estimates 4 to 5. No designer sourced; omit.

facts.claim: Style family for Get the look: elongated solitaire (step or cushion cut).

insider_details.detail: Four of the batch B rings are step-cut or elongated stones (Beyonce, Amal Clooney, Sofia Richie Grainge, Jennifer Lawrence): a useful cluster for readers who like a clean, architectural look. As advice: step cuts show clarity more than brilliant cuts, so ask a jeweller to show the stone face up in daylight.

Side stones change the label: Priyanka Chopra Jonas and Miranda Kerr are often listed as solitaires, but sources describe tapered baguettes on either side, so they belong in the side-stone or three-stone family.
Zendaya's ring is reported as set east-west in a Georgian-style cut-down setting, which is the cleanest sourced example of the east-west trend for the style table.

Taylor Swift's ring is in a yellow gold bezel setting; as general advice, a bezel wraps the stone's edge, which suits travel and active days more than high prongs (link the active lifestyle settings guide).
Emma Stone's ring has an Akoya pearl centre; as general care advice, pearls are softer than diamonds, so take a pearl ring off for swimming, sunscreen and salt water at a beach or island wedding.

Coloured accents appear in two modern rings (Blake Lively's pink oval diamond, Lady Gaga's pink diamond accents), giving the coloured-stone family a modern counterpart to the royal sapphires in batch A.
